title: Text Clean Geometry Stability v1
problem: Decide and prove which text nodes may participate in clean-geometry resize propagation without rerunning authoritative layout, while keeping wrapped and width-derived text on the authoritative path until line-break and computed-box stability evidence exists.

repro.summary: Run the focused text clean-geometry boundary gate before changing text layout eligibility. The current contract accepts cached nowrap text only and rejects wrapped or height-changing text as text_reflow.

gates.name: text-clean-geometry-diag-bundle
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag run tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/text-wrap/ui-gallery-text-measure-overlay-window-resize-drag-jitter-steady.json --dir target/fret-diag/text-clean-geometry-detail-20260521-r1 --session-auto --pack --ai-packet --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --features gallery-dev

continue_policy.notes: The boundary and diagnostics proof is complete. Do not continue implementation in this lane by default. Start a new behavior-changing follow-on only if fresh evidence shows wrapped text is a material perf owner, and do not enable TextWrap::Word or shadcn CardDescription clean-geometry propagation until a dedicated line-break/computed-box signature proves unchanged layout, measure, glyph, and paint outcomes.
